parent_objective: design closed-loop replay admission for M689 residual heads

public_gates: design compares base actor and M689 residual-corrected action
design includes wrong-history or boundary-risk utility gates
design uses source-heldout or source-diverse rows

stop_condition: stop this branch if no closed-loop or replay admission gate can be defined without weakening the exact output gates

stop after the branch cadence unless an explicit synthesis artifact selects continue or pivot

hypothesis: A closed-loop replay admission design can test whether M689's exact residual-head output separation has trajectory-level utility without changing the base actor or admitting PPO.
success_criteria: wrong-history or boundary-risk utility gates are specified
source-heldout or source-diverse evaluation is specified
PPO, actor update, and promotion remain blocked
failure_criteria: design treats M689 exact output gates as closed-loop evidence
design admits PPO or actor update
design omits wrong-history or boundary-risk utility gates
decision_rule: M691 passes if it defines a no-training replay admission gate that can decide whether M689 residual corrections deserve any later actor-update branch while preserving P0 inputs and blocking PPO/promotion.
